title: The Integration Trap
subtitle: Core Banking APIs, SOAP/REST Integration & LDAP/SSO Dependencies
description: The player is managing Project Amigo, an HRMS implementation for ICICI Bank involving 80,000 employees and a 90-day deadline. The team is now attempting to integrate the HRMS with the bank's existing systems. Services expect JSON over REST, while the legacy ESB uses SOAP/XML. Triage the blocker, choose the safe integration gateway, and sequence dependencies.

stakeholders.name: Daniel Brooks
stakeholders.agenda: Discovers the integration problem, shares his screen, and explains the logs.

stakeholders.name: Aarav Kapoor
stakeholders.agenda: Helps the player understand the project implications and provides access to the integration portal.

stakeholders.name: Marcus Reed
stakeholders.agenda: Establishes the security and architecture constraints and reacts to the player's integration decision.

objectives.label: Triage protocol mismatch & analyze engineering logs
Decide integration architecture without bypassing bank controls
Prioritize & sequence dependency resolution and safe parallel testing
